environment.timeout_preflight_warning: options.timeout_s (600s) looks implausible for a tran analysis with ~1.3e+05 timepoints (10p step, 1300n window) -- even 50 timepoints/s (a generous floor, not a real engine-rate estimate) would need 2.6e+03s per corner.
